vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: web-slides
Version: 2.0.1

The bundle is a comprehensive toolset for generating premium, single-file HTML slide decks from Markdown or JSON inputs. The core logic in 'scripts/generate-slide-html.mjs' and 'scripts/markdown-to-content.mjs' is well-structured and focused entirely on the stated purpose of presentation generation. While the bundle uses 'execFileSync' in 'scripts/chrome-utils.mjs' and 'scripts/build-preview-gallery.mjs' to automate builds and capture screenshots via headless Chrome, these operations are handled safely using argument arrays and are functionally necessary for the 'preview' features. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious prompt injection, or unauthorized network activity.

llm.summary: The skill's files, runtime instructions, and required resources are consistent with a local, template-driven HTML slide generator and do not request unrelated credentials or hidden network access.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the included code and docs: this is a template-and-script-based single-file HTML slide generator. The scripts and references are proportional to that purpose (theme catalog, layout system, markdown conversion, HTML generation, optional preview rendering). No unrelated credentials, binaries, or external services are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md confines runtime behavior to local operations: reading reference docs, selecting themes/layouts, running node scripts, optionally using headless Chrome for PNG previews. It does not instruct reading unrelated system state, sending data to remote endpoints, or fetching API keys. The scripts operate on repository files and output to local dist/ paths.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is present (instruction-only). Code is provided as Node scripts that rely on built-in Node modules and a local Chrome binary for optional preview rendering. There are no network downloads, no external package installs declared, and no archive extraction from arbitrary URLs.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. The only env usage is an optional CHROME_BIN in chrome-utils.mjs to override the default Chrome path; this is reasonable for preview rendering. No secrets or unrelated credentials are requested or used.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false; the skill does not request permanent platform presence. Scripts write generated artifacts to local 'dist/' directories (normal for a generator). There is no code modifying other skills, global agent settings, or accessing other skills' configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and self-contained: it generates single-file HTML slide decks using local Node scripts and optional headless Chrome previews. Before running: 1) inspect the repository and run it in a dedicated/sandbox directory so generated files (dist/) don't mix with other data; 2) ensure you have Node and (optionally) Google Chrome (or set CHROME_BIN) if you want PNG previews; 3) be aware the scripts invoke child processes (node and Chrome) locally — expected for preview generation but worth noting if you run in restricted environments; 4) because the skill runs code shipped in the bundle, only install/use it from sources you trust (the package metadata shows an unknown source/homepage). If you want extra assurance, run the smoke-test script (node scripts/smoke-test.mjs) in an isolated environment and review the generated HTML before sharing publicly.
